pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions exhibiting deeply incised, stellate margins with sharp pixel-level gradients. Dark brown regions vary in spatial area, becoming significantly smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating dark patches. Topography includes frequent tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes with a pixel thickness approximately 5-10% of the adjacent patch width.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency 1D geometric contour consisting of dark brown filamentary pixels visible against the sky and background blur along the dorsal neck.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two oxpeckers (Buphagus) attached to the specimen: one on the dorsal-lateral neck and one on the lower ventral-lateral neck. Partial visibility of a zebra (Equus quagga) pattern in the background/underbelly region.
